title: Fixes to workforce housing law chapter 2.96
summary: The board's May 29 review of proposed changes to chapter 2.96, the residential workforce housing law, was adjourned over a meeting link problem and a possible Sunshine Law violation. All items will be reposted, and the next meeting is June 26. The department had proposed defining area median income, which the chapter uses but never defines, and fixing code that wrongly points to it for fee waiver definitions.

timeline.text: The chair said reposting gives the public more time to review the items and prepare testimony.
Staff confirmed the next meeting is June 26.

A county lawyer said a problem with the agenda's meeting link might violate the Sunshine Law, a public meeting law.
The department proposed defining area median income, a term used throughout chapter 2.96 but not defined.
The department said Bill 88, a fee waiver bill, has not yet been added to the code.

The department said one proposed fix matters because it relates to fee waivers.
The board is reviewing a department chart of proposed changes to chapter 2.96, the county's residential workforce housing law.
The Director of Housing said his department is fine with the bill's language.
